slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, You name is higher than every other name
Situations bow to Your name
The heavens proclaim Your righteousness
And all the people see Your glory

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: In Your name, is all power
In Your name, there are solutions
Lord, Your name is the answer to all things
Things are changed in Your name

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: In Your name, is all power
In Your name, there are solutions
Every miracle displays
Your eternal perfection
Things are changed in Your name

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: In the heavens and the earth
All authority is found in Your name
We declare Your name in all the earth
Your marvelous works among all people
